snippet.title: Dave Kerr | Effective NodeJS Debugging
snippet.description: In this talk I will demonstrate techniques for debugging NodeJS applications. With a set of examples, I'll show you how to quickly and easily debug applications and test suites, accelerating your development and making troubleshooting more effective.

snippet.title: Ajay Shrivastava | Solver Teams - Hyper Agile, Well Oiled Execution
Douglas Crockford speaks on "The Better Parts"
snippet.description:
Douglas Crockford
Discovered the JSON & works at Paypal

Douglas Crockford was born in the Frostbite Falls, Minnesota, but left when he was only six months old because it was just too damn cold. He turned his back on a promising career in television when he discovered computers. He has worked in learning systems, small business systems, office automation, games, interactive music, multimedia, location-based entertainment, social systems, and programming languages. He is the inventor of Tilton, the ugliest programming language that was not specifically designed to be an ugly programming language. He is best known for having discovered that there are good parts in JavaScript. This was an important and unexpected discovery. He also discovered the JSON Data Interchange Format, the world's most loved data format. And he works at Paypal.

Douglas Crockford will speak on "The Better Parts"

snippet.title: Suchit Puri on "What EmberJS taught us in past year".
snippet.description:
Suchit Puri
Application Developer at Thoughtworks

Suchit Puri ,an alumnus from BITS Pilani and currently working as a application developer at Thoughtworks is an agilist and ardent follower of XP best practices like TDD, Pair Programming, Continuous Integration and continuous deployments. He has worked for clients ranging from small startups to big MNC's ; getting involved during project inceptions/client management, juggling many hats; doing analysis, coding, deployments and automation during a project's life-cycle.He has also been doing consulting on Agile Adoption , TDD ,CI.

Suchit Puri will speak on "What EmberJS taught us in past year."

snippet.title: Hemanth on The new gen of gen{}
Amod Malviya on "Continuous Platformization"
snippet.description:
Amod Malviya
CTO, Flipkart

Amod heads the Engineering setup that powers Flipkart.com. Having joined the engineering team during its infancy as a Sr. Engineering Manager, he has grown wearing multiple hats at a time, playing a critical role in helping Flipkart.com reach where it is today. Prior to joining Flipkart.com, Amod has worked at multiple technology startups, mostly into consumer Internet and distributed system spaces. He is an avid technology contributor, a strong open source proponent, and is very passionate about making India a technology powerhouse.

snippet.title: Sunil Pai on node @myntra
snippet.description:
Sunil Pai - Frontend Architect at Myntra

Myntra spent the last year or so transitioning over most of their user facing services/pages to node. Sunil was part of this effort, and helped move the company over from a php stack to a service oriented stack around node. He learnt a number of things along the way, and he'd like to share some of these with the rest of the community. Sunil experimented heavily with parallelizing middleware stacks, isomorphic modules, in-house build/deploy systems, SEO-friendly single page applications, and so on. Sunil managed to replace many servers with few, and have a fun ops setup that makes it quite nice to work with.

Sunil Pai will speak on "node @myntra"
